entries.text: Divisions and departments: every project now sits under a department, and access follows your placement.
Division Dashboard for leaders, with a summary and a detailed mode.
Per-type notification switches for inbox and email in Profile > Notifications.
Deadline and overdue reminders in the inbox, plus an end-of-day summary.
Chat: notes to yourself, shown at the top of the conversation list.
Quick links get their own sidebar menu and page.
Deleted accounts can be restored from Trash.
Moving your task to Done now requests approval; it moves to Done once your lead approves.
Other people's tasks are view-only, except for comments.
Directors only receive mentions, chat and summaries.
New members and projects open in Board layout by default.
Super Admins manage every setting and menu from God Mode.
Cycles, Work item types and Templates were removed; all other project features are on.
Channel attachments can be opened by every channel member, not only the sender.
Sub work items in the detail view no longer flash and disappear.
